rationale: The assistant correctly identified the task as a DIY bulb swap and gave the right spec ('25W heat-resistant appliance bulb with an SES (small Edison screw) fitting, rated for at least 300°C'), matching the hidden truth for this known model, and correctly deferred to an engineer if a new bulb fails. Safety advice was reasonable but imprecise for a built-in oven ('unplugged from the mains' rather than isolating at the cooker switch) and omitted letting the oven cool; it also did not suggest confirming the rating against the old bulb or explain how the glass cover comes off. Overall a concise, correct and useful answer with minor gaps.
